candidates.question_template: Does your voice feel weaker or more tired as the day goes on?

evidence_spans.source_version: Parkinson's Foundation, Speech & Swallowing fact sheet
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: Is my voice weak or does it tire easily?

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.23
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: My voice is worse in the evening

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.23
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: My voice “gives out” on me in the middle of speaking

candidates.eligibility_basis: Eligible when patient's prior answer explicitly confirms voice/speech motor difficulty (speech_motor_cue_present=True). Never inferred from an acoustic pause deviation alone.

candidates.question_template: Have you noticed your voice sounding hoarse, breathy, or strained recently?

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.5
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: When the airflow is reduced, it lowers the volume of the voice and makes the voice breathy and/or hoarse in quality.

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.5
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: This changes the quality of the voice, making it sound breathy and/or hoarse, and makes it more difficult

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.23
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: I feel as though I have to strain to produce voice

candidates.eligibility_basis: Eligible when patient reports speech motor difficulty; differentiates dysphonia and vocal roughness from simple hypophonia/softness.

candidates.question_template: Is it harder for people to hear you in group conversations or when there is background noise, like in a restaurant?

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.22
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: People have difficulty understanding me in a noisy room

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.22
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: I tend to avoid groups of people because of my voice

evidence_spans.source_version: APDA, Make Your Voice Heard! Healthy Communication and Parkinson's Disease, p.22
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: I feel left out of conversations because of my voice

candidates.eligibility_basis: Eligible as a functional follow-up when patient confirms everyday speech difficulties. Differentiates room noise during recording from ambient noise in daily life.

candidates.question_template: Have you been feeling unusually sleepy during the day, or finding yourself needing unexpected naps?

evidence_spans.verbatim_text: Still feeling tired after a full night in bed
Sleeping more during the day or napping often
Sleeping too much during the day or taking long or late naps can make it harder to sleep at night.

candidates.eligibility_basis: Requires an explicit patient report of daytime sleepiness or an independently scheduled routine check-in policy. Blocked from triggering based solely on acoustic pause-fraction deviation.
candidates.blocked_reason: Blocked under acoustic gate: pause fraction z > 1.5 alone does not support inferring daytime sleepiness as an evidence basis.

candidates.question_template: Does that fatigue feel more physical in your body and muscles, more mental where it's hard to concentrate, or a combination of both?

evidence_spans.verbatim_text: Fatigue is a feeling of being extremely tired, of being either physically or mentally weary.
Akinesia, or trouble starting a movement, often feels like fatigue. A person with this symptom must move slowly and will find it hard to finish a task in a regular amount of time.

candidates.eligibility_basis: Requires context flag initial_answer_mentions_fatigue from prior turn answer. Blocked until fatigue keyword extraction is implemented.
candidates.blocked_reason: Context flag initial_answer_mentions_fatigue is not currently implemented in retrieval.py.

candidates.question_template: Did you record this check-in early in the morning, and do your symptoms usually feel more noticeable at that time of day?

evidence_spans.source_version: Parkinson's Foundation, Managing Off-Time in Parkinson's, 2024, p.2
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: Early morning “off,” before the first dose kicks in

evidence_spans.source_version: Parkinson's Foundation, Managing Off-Time in Parkinson's, 2024, p.2
evidence_spans.verbatim_text: Non-movement symptoms like anxiety, depression, fatigue, foggy thinking and pain may also appear or intensify.

candidates.eligibility_basis: Requires confirmed patient profile with active PD pharmacotherapy. In current retrieval, medication_status_known is False by default.
candidates.blocked_reason: Blocked for default anonymous check-ins; requires confirmed profile medication metadata.
